projects.title: Folibuddy: AI-Powered Resume to Portfolio Generator
description: Automated conversion of PDF resumes into deployable personal websites, implementing backend in Python, backed with FastAPI and Google Gemini API to orchestrate parsing and site generation.

Implemented structured LLM outputs for resume parsing and built an editable input interface enabling users to review, add, modify, basically personalise extracted content before publishing the site to a custom domain/URL.

projects.title: RakxRag: Agentic Compliance RAG Engine
description: Architected a self-correcting Agentic RAG system in Python featuring a multi-stage reasoning loop (Decompose → Grade → Rewrite) that autonomously evaluates context quality and regenerates queries to minimise hallucinations and ensure grounded answers.

Engineered a high-precision retrieval engine using Qdrant, implementing Hybrid Search (Dense + BM25) fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and FlashRank cross-encoder reranking to achieve superior accuracy for both semantic and exact-keyword queries.

Optimised performance and cost through a tiered LLM strategy, leveraging local Mistral (Ollama) for reasoning and fact-checking while reserving Gemini 2.0 Flash for final synthesis, reducing cloud API consumption by ∼80 %.

projects.title: BMSIT Faculty App
description: Built a Faculty Onboarding System using FastAPI (Python) and React.js, implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to manage administrative and faculty workflows.
Implemented authentication and security workflows using JWT for session management, bcrypt password hashing, and a multi-step first-login flow with automated temporary credentials and expiry logic.
Designed and documented RESTful APIs backed by MongoDB, integrating an SMTP email service (with mock mode) and delivering full CRUD functionality for user profile management.

Built and maintaining a digital education platform enabling structured content delivery using TypeScript, NestJS for backend and frontend using Next.js, TypeScript and React, styled with TailwindCSS and used PostgreSQL for the database.
Refactored the application into a modular, scalable architecture with RESTful APIs and authentication using JWT and bcrypt, reducing average latency from ∼25 ms to ∼3 ms.
Optimized database performance by designing indexes, constraints and schema improvements, increasing throughput.

research.title: Early Detection of Neonatal Sepsis using Federated Learning
description: Built a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for early neonatal sepsis prediction, enabling secure multi-hospital EHR training using Flower and FedAvg, ensuring HIPAA- and GDPR-compliant collaboration.
Developed GRU-D and Transformer time-series models on 40 NICU clinical features, improving AUROC from 0.829 → 0.893 and accuracy from 73.9% → 94.7% to enhance early detection reliability.

Strengthened clinical decision support by increasing precision from 0.187 to 0.712 (∼280 ) and reducing the false-positive rate from 0.2422 to 0.0147, minimising alarm fatigue and unnecessary interventions.
